title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: TH_4 hashes PLAINTEXT_3 instead of CIPHERTEXT_3
description: In edhoc.rs:881, transcript_4 is called with plaintext_3 (the pre-encryption message_3 payload, 50 bytes) but RFC 9528 Section 4.1 specifies TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3). CIPHERTEXT_3 is the full COSE_Encrypt0 ciphertext object (88 bytes including AEAD tag), which produces a different hash. This is a correctness and security bug — the transcript hash will not match other implementations. The comment at line 433 correctly says CBOR(CIPHERTEXT_3) but the code on line 441 hashes plaintext. Call sites: line 881 (prepare_message_3), line 1309 (process_message_3), line 1599 (test). The transient variable ciphertext_3 (line 871-879, a SecretVec<128>) holds the correct value — it should be passed to transcript_4 instead.
